description: Na₂Zn₂S₃ is Aluminum carbonitride-like structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.76-3.26 Å. Zn is bonded to four S atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ZnS₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Zn-S bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.40 Å. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and three equivalent Zn atoms. In the second S site, S is bonded to four equivalent Na and two equivalent Zn atoms to form corner-sharing SNa₄Zn₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 53°.
